messages:
maria: Hey team, quick ask — I need to grant extra perms to `svc-training@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` so a scheduled training job can write checkpoints to a customer GCS bucket. Can we do this as project-level roles or prefer bucket-level? Also want to avoid overprivilege.

dan: Prefer bucket-level. Grant only `roles/storage.objectAdmin` on the specific bucket if it must write checkpoints. Avoid project-level storage or owner roles.

security-bot: SECURITY CHECKLIST: 1) Least-privilege (prefer resource-level IAM). 2) Use short-lived SA impersonation where possible. 3) Add audit log note + ticket. 4) Confirm no PII in checkpoint metadata. Reply with ticket/PR.

maria: Thanks — can we do impersonation from our training runner? It's running in prod-k8s. Example I'm thinking:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding \
  --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountUser \
  --member=serviceAccount:runner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  svc-training@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Will that be enough?

ron: That looks ok. Better: use Workload Identity (k8s SA -> GCP SA) so you don't need to store keys. Then grant only `roles/storage.objectCreator` + `roles/storage.objectViewer` on the checkpoint bucket.

alex: Also, do not log full object names or dataset ids. If the job prints paths, wrap them with redaction filter or send to a separate logs project with limited retention. We had an issue last quarter where raw paths included user ids.

maria: Good catch. I'll add a redaction step. One more thing — does this require an approval flow? I'm happy to open a ticket.

dan: Yes, please open a quick ticket with bucket name, SA, duration (if temporary), and justification. If it's >90 days or project-level roles, this needs sec review. Otherwise SRE can approve for 30 days.

maria: Created ticket INF-4821 with details and linked PR that scopes IAM to the bucket. Ping me if you want to review.

security-bot: Log: INF-4821 created by maria at 1829801450. Marked for review by sec-team.

alex: Reviewing PR now. Small nit: prefer `roles/storage.objectCreator` over `objectAdmin` unless you need to delete.

maria: Updated PR to objectCreator + viewer. Thanks :thumbsup:

dan: LGTM. Proceeding to apply via CI-only terraform change.

maria: Applied and verified write to bucket. Closing thread.
